reasoning_content: Supabase läuft extern - ich muss die URLs/Env aus den Docker-Containern kriegen. Lass mich die Supabase-Docker-Env lesen.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# List supabase container ports to find services
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker port supabase-kong 2>&1")
print("Kong:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check what ports services run on
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker inspect supabase-db --format '{{.NetworkSettings.Ports}}' 2>&1 | head -5")
print("DB ports:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
